text:
aj (eng-platform): Heads-up — product wants a small set of KV/prefix cache effectiveness metrics surfaced in the console for the rollout next month. Need runtime + infra inputs on what's feasible. TL;DR: hit rate, eviction rate, reuse_by_workload, and a cold-start indicator.

maria (eng-runtime): +1. We already emit low-level counters but there are gaps in labels (workload, model_variant, request_route). Current metrics: `kv_cache_hits_total`, `kv_cache_misses_total`, `kv_cache_evictions_total`, `kv_cache_bytes`.

jin (eng-infra): We can pipeline those into metrics ingestion but cardinality will explode if the workload label is free-form. Need an agreed set of tags. Suggest `workload_id`, `route`, `model_family`.

sam (eng-console): For console UX we want prebuilt panels: 1) global hit rate (1m/5m), 2) per-workload reuse heatmap, 3) eviction spikes with top offending routes, 4) cold-start rate. Also want alert hooks for regressions.

leo (eng-ml): Important: hit rate must be defined consistently. Do we compute hit_rate = hits / (hits+misses) at runtime (sum over interval) or pre-aggregated per-request? For reuse_by_workload we need to count unique prefixes reused per minute, not just hits.

katie (product): The PM ask: simple signals so customers can see when their workloads stop benefiting from prefix caching. They don't need raw counters, just an actionable "cache health" bar and a way to inspect which routes are cold.

aj (eng-platform): Proposal from platform: we ship two metric groups: "kv_effectiveness" (aggregated) and "kv_debug" (high-cardinality, sampled). `kv_effectiveness` will have low-cardinality labels: `env`, `region`, `model_family`, `route_group`. `kv_debug` will include `workload_id` and be emitted at 1% sampling. Thoughts?

maria (eng-runtime): Sampling approach is OK. Implementation notes: runtime can produce derived gauges: `kv_hit_rate` (gauge, computed as rate(hits)/(rate(hits)+rate(misses)) ), `kv_eviction_rate` (rate(evictions)/avg(cache_size)). We'll implement tags for `route_group` but we need a mapping table in infra that maps route->group.

jin (eng-infra): We'll own the route->group mapping in config service. Need a small schema: `route_group:string`, `sla_tier:string`. We'll also add a job to roll up sampled `kv_debug` into a daily histogram to assist debugging without keeping raw high-cardinality live.

sam (eng-console): For dashboard queries, can you provide example PromQLs? Even pseudo-promql is fine. E.g.: `sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m])) / sum(rate(kv_cache_hits_total{env="prod"}[5m]) + rate(kv_cache_misses_total{env="prod"}[5m]))` for global hit rate panel. Also want a panel for "top-10 routes by eviction spike" with `increase(kv_cache_evictions_total[5m])` grouped by `route_group`.

leo (eng-ml): Also add a reuse metric which is `prefix_reuse_ratio = distinct_prefix_reuses / total_prefixes_seen` — but distinct counts are expensive. Suggest an approximation using HyperLogLog sketches exported periodically, or store sampled distinct counts per workload.

aj (eng-platform): Good point — sketch output could go to our telemetry pipeline (daily) and the console shows 24h reuse approximation. For realtime we show hit rate + eviction spikes.

katie (product): UX ask: add a timeline view that overlays hit_rate, QPS, and evictions so product can correlate. And a button to "view sampled keys" (read-only) for customers to see example prefixes causing misses (privacy-sanitized).

maria (eng-runtime): We'll add an endpoint to fetch sampled miss keys (sanitized) and a sampling flag `kv_sample_payloads=true` only enabled for customer opt-in / internal review. Default off.

jin (eng-infra): Operational note: set retention for `kv_debug` short (7d) and `kv_effectiveness` longer (90d). Also add an ingestion-side dedupe to avoid blowing out TSDB when the same labelset is emitted by many pods at same time.

sam (eng-console): UX details: want an SLO card: "cache health" computed as 14-day 95th percentile hit_rate >= 0.7. Also a rollout UX: when we deploy model variants, surface a canary row that compares canary vs baseline hit_rate + evictions.

leo (eng-ml): For canary comparisons, use bootstrap CI on the hit_rate time series, or provide a simple delta + confidence interval. We can produce that as a derived metric pipeline if platform wants.

aj (eng-platform): Action items: 1) runtime: add `route_group` tag + derived gauges (maria) 2) infra: build route->group mapping + ingestion rules + retention (jin) 3) console: mock panels + PromQL snippets (sam) 4) ml: HLL sketch plan for reuse_by_workload (leo) 5) product: finalize UX copy and opt-in policy for sampled keys (katie).

aj (eng-platform): I'll open a tracking ticket with the mapping doc and mockups. Target: prototype dashboard + sampling in staging by 1801900000 (2 weeks).

deploy-bot: deploy started for platform/telemetry-pipeline@v2.3.1 — ETA ~12m :rocket:

katie (product): thanks — please @channel when the staging dashboard is up so PMs can poke it. :eyes:
